completions.completed_label: Cerebral Vasculitis with diffuse stenosis and beaded pattern of arteries
completions.reason: The vignette describes specific angiographic findings consistent with a particular pattern of cerebral vasculitis.
support_spans: diffuse stenosis and a beaded pattern of the anterior and middle cerebral arteries and their branches, along with diffuse luminal narrowing and dysplastic changes in the right distal vertebral artery and basilar trunk, consistent with cerebral angiitis
